day4_afternoon_start.name: Me
day4_afternoon_start.text: *We left the café and walked together through the streets. Before I knew it, afternoon had arrived.*

day4_walk_together.name: Me
day4_walk_together.text: *We walked side by side, looking around at the scenery. It was the weekend, so the streets were pretty crowded. Laughter, music, and sweet aromas all blended together.*

day4_walk_street.name: Me
day4_walk_street.text: *I caught our reflection in a shop window. We looked just like a real couple… My heart started racing.*

day4_walk_market.name: Me
day4_walk_market.text: *A small market came into view down a side alley. Delicious smells drifted in on the breeze. My mouth was watering.*

day4_walk_food_choice.name: Me
day4_walk_food_choice.text: *A street food stall caught my eye. What should I do?*
choices: "Looks delicious… Let's just browse for a bit."

day4_walk_food_share.name: Me
day4_walk_food_share.text: (I bought a fish-shaped pastry and split it in half. Warm steam rose from it. "Here, half for you." My hand trembled slightly as I offered it.)

day4_walk_food_look.name: Me
day4_walk_food_look.text: *As we browsed in front of the stall, our shoulders brushed against each other. My heart lurched. I pretended not to notice, but I'm pretty sure I was blushing up to my ears.*

day4_walk_close.name: Me
day4_walk_close.text: *We walked side by side back out to the main road. The streets had grown quieter. The sunset's glow stretched long between the buildings.*

day4_walk_feelings.name: Me
day4_walk_feelings.text: *I can't believe just walking together like this can make me this happy. I stole a glance at the person beside me. Something… an emotion I couldn't put into words was welling up inside me.*

day4_afternoon_walk.name: Me
day4_afternoon_walk.text: *I never knew walking side by side could feel this good. Every time our fingertips brushed, my heart pounded.*

day4_special_notice.name: Me
day4_special_notice.text: *As we walked, some charming shops tucked away in the alley caught my eye. My companion pointed at one of them.*

day4_special_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_special_seoyeon.text: "Look over there, a flower shop! Let's go check it out!"

day4_special_seoyeon_react.name: Me
day4_special_seoyeon_react.text: (Seoyeon beamed among the flowers, picked out a single blossom, and held it out to me. "This one's for you. The flower meaning is… a secret.")

day4_special_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_special_yuna.text: "…There's a used bookstore over there. Would it be okay if we stopped in?"

day4_special_yuna_react.name: Me
day4_special_yuna_react.text: (Yuna carefully pulled a book from the old shelves. "This book… I wanted to read it together with you." Her eyes shimmered softly.)
choices: "Let's read it together. One chapter a day."
"If you picked it, I'm sure it's a great book."

day4_special_dain.name: Dain
day4_special_dain.text: "Oh! A sports store!! Hold on, there's something I need to check out!"

day4_special_dain_react.name: Me
day4_special_dain_react.text: (Dain came running over excitedly with matching wristbands. "Look at these, couple wristbands! Let's each wear one!" Her face was slightly flushed.)
choices: "You pick them out, you've got great taste."

day4_special_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_special_nurse.text: "Oh my, an antique shop over there. Shall we have a look?"

day4_special_nurse_react.name: Me
day4_special_nurse_react.text: (She held up a vintage brooch, tilting it in the sunlight with a smile. "Isn't this pretty? Something about it… makes me want to keep it forever.")
choices: "It would look great on you. Can I buy it for you?"
"You have a good eye. It's really beautiful."

day4_special_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_special_teacher.text: "Wait, can we stop by that stationery store? I need a pen."

day4_special_teacher_react.name: Me
day4_special_teacher_react.text: (She was picking out a pen when she paused and grabbed another one. "…This one's for you. Make sure you take good notes in class. …It's a gift." She turned away, but the tips of her ears were red.)
choices: "Thank you. I'll use it every day."
"It's even more special because you picked it out."

day4_afternoon_special.name: Me
day4_afternoon_special.text: (It was a special time together. "Hey, want to head to the riverside park?" My companion suggested it first.)

day4_afternoon_park.name: Me
day4_afternoon_park.text: *We arrived at the riverside park. The sunset was sparkling on the water. It looked like a scene straight out of a movie.*

day4_sunset_approach.name: Me
day4_sunset_approach.text: *We walked slowly along the riverbank. The sunset light shimmered across the water, painting golden ripples. Time seemed to slow down.*

day4_sunset_colors.name: Me
day4_sunset_colors.text: *The sky shifted from orange to pink, and then to violet. I don't think I've ever seen a sky this beautiful in my entire life.*

day4_sunset_wind.name: Me
day4_sunset_wind.text: *A warm breeze brushed past us. The wind from the river carried the scent of grass and water. The gentle sound of flowing water played like background music.*

day4_sunset_stare_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon was leaning on the railing, gazing at the sunset. Her hair fluttered in the breeze. Her profile, bathed in the glow of the setting sun… was breathtakingly beautiful.*

day4_sunset_stare_yuna.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_yuna.text: *Yuna was quietly watching the sunset. Her usually expressionless face had softened gently. I've… never seen her look like this before.*

day4_sunset_stare_dain.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_dain.text: *Dain let out a small gasp of awe. Unlike her usual energetic self, she stood still, gazing at the sunset. She looked unexpectedly mature.*

day4_sunset_stare_nurse.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_nurse.text: *She gazed at the sunset with her eyes gently narrowed. Bathed in the glow of the setting sun, she looked like a painting come to life.*

day4_sunset_stare_teacher.name: Me
day4_sunset_stare_teacher.text: *She leaned quietly against the railing, looking down at the river. Her usual strictness was nowhere to be seen, replaced by a soft, gentle smile.*

day4_afternoon_sunset.name: Me
day4_afternoon_sunset.text: *The sunset was illuminating their face. Strangely, I couldn't find any words to say.*

day4_afternoon_feeling.name: Me
day4_afternoon_feeling.text: *I think I finally know what this feeling is. From the very first day I transferred here until now… I've been feeling it all along.*

day4_confession_choice.name: Me
day4_confession_choice.text: *Right now, in this moment… should I tell them how I feel?*
choices: "There's something I need to tell you…"  (Confess)

day4_confess.name: Me
day4_confess.text: "The truth is… ever since I transferred here, all I've thought about every day is you."

day4_confess_heartbeat.name: Me
day4_confess_heartbeat.text: *My heart was pounding like crazy. Thump, thump, thump. Can they hear it too?*

day4_confess_2.name: Me
day4_confess_2.text: "At first, I just thought you were a good person… but now I'm sure."

day4_confess_breathe.name: Me
day4_confess_breathe.text: *I took a deep breath. I clenched my fists. If not now… I'll regret it for the rest of my life.*

day4_confess_silence.name: Me
day4_confess_silence.text: *As soon as the words left my mouth, silence fell. The world bathed in the sunset's glow seemed to stop. Every second felt like an hour.*

day4_confess_to_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_confess_to_seoyeon.text: "Seoyeon… seeing your smile every morning has become the reason I start my day. I've never felt anything like this before."

day4_confess_to_yuna.name: Me
day4_confess_to_yuna.text: "Yuna… when I'm with you, the world feels quiet. I love that stillness. It's special because it's you."

day4_confess_to_dain.name: Me
day4_confess_to_dain.text: "Dain… when you smile, I can't help but smile too. Your bright energy is contagious. At some point, it started feeling empty without you around."

day4_confess_to_nurse.name: Me
day4_confess_to_nurse.text: "I'm not saying this as a student… I'm saying this as a person. I like you. I truly mean it."

day4_confess_to_teacher.name: Me
day4_confess_to_teacher.text: "Whether you're being strict or smiling… I've liked every side of you. These feelings are genuine, and they're only for you."

day4_accept_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_accept_seoyeon.text: "…Me too. I like you too. Ever since the first day you transferred in, when I first saw you at the school gate."

day4_accept_seoyeon_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_seoyeon_moment.text: *Tears were welling up in Seoyeon's eyes. Those tears, sparkling in the sunset's glow… were like the most beautiful jewels in the world.*

day4_accept_seoyeon_close.name: Seoyeon
day4_accept_seoyeon_close.text: "…Can I hold your hand?"  (Seoyeon gently wrapped her hand around mine. It was warm, and trembling slightly.)

day4_accept_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_accept_yuna.text: "…Dummy. I was going to say it first."

day4_accept_yuna_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_yuna_moment.text: *Yuna slightly lowered her head. I could see the blush spreading all the way to the tips of her ears. This was completely different from how she usually is… my heart felt like it would burst.*

day4_accept_yuna_close.name: Yuna
day4_accept_yuna_close.text: "…Stay still."  (Yuna moved right next to me and stood close. Our shoulders were touching. A small warmth radiated between us.)

day4_accept_dain.name: Dain
day4_accept_dain.text: "…Huh?! F-for real?! Me too!! I like you too!! Oh my gosh!!"

day4_accept_dain_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_dain_moment.text: *Dain grabbed my arm with both hands. Her face was flushed bright red, but her eyes were sparkling with joy.*

day4_accept_dain_close.name: Dain
day4_accept_dain_close.text: "Hehe, so we're officially dating now, right?! Really?! Ahh, my heart's gonna explode!!"  (Dain bounced up and down, grabbing my hand and shaking it.)

day4_accept_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_accept_nurse.text: "…I already knew. I could tell just by looking into your eyes. …I feel the same way."

day4_accept_nurse_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_nurse_moment.text: *She took a step closer. A faint, gentle fragrance brushed past my nose. My heart felt like it might stop.*

day4_accept_nurse_close.name: School Nurse
day4_accept_nurse_close.text: "It's a secret, just between us."  (She gently took my hand. Her soft, warm hand… was trembling.)

day4_accept_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_accept_teacher.text: "…Honestly, you. You know a student shouldn't say things like that to a teacher, right? …But I feel the same way, you dummy."

day4_accept_teacher_moment.name: Me
day4_accept_teacher_moment.text: *Her eyes were wavering. Getting to see this vulnerable side of someone who's always so guarded… I must be the only one who gets to see this.*

day4_accept_teacher_close.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_accept_teacher_close.text: "…Just this much."  (She linked her pinky finger with mine. "At school… it's a secret.")

day4_after_confess.name: Me
day4_after_confess.text: *Beneath the sunset, our two shadows merged into one. It was the happiest moment in the world.*

day4_wait_conflict.name: Me
day4_wait_conflict.text: *The words I wanted to say rose all the way to the tip of my tongue… but I swallowed them back down. Not yet… it's not the right time yet.*

day4_wait_walk.name: Me
day4_wait_walk.text: *We walked side by side along the riverbank. Neither of us said a word, but somehow, the silence wasn't uncomfortable at all.*

day4_wait_linger.name: Me
day4_wait_linger.text: *We'd have to part ways at the crosswalk up ahead. I never knew taking a single step could be this hard.*

day4_wait_feelings.name: Me
day4_wait_feelings.text: *The words I swallowed earlier came surging back up. 'I like you.' Those three words were pounding against the walls of my heart.*

day4_wait_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_wait_seoyeon.text: "Me too! Let's hang out again… okay?"  (Seoyeon smiled brightly, but somewhere deep in her eyes, a hint of longing showed.)

day4_wait_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_wait_yuna.text: "…Yeah. It wasn't bad. …Let's do this again sometime."  (Yuna turned her head slightly. Was she trying to hide her expression?)

day4_wait_dain.name: Dain
day4_wait_dain.text: "Of course it was fun!! Let's go out again next time!!"  (Dain smiled brightly, but for a moment, I caught her biting her lip.)

day4_wait_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_wait_nurse.text: "It was a lovely time. …Shall we meet up again?"  (Her smile seemed just a bit weaker than usual.)

day4_wait_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_wait_teacher.text: "…Well, it wasn't bad. Call me again next time. I'll come."  (She smiled, but her steps as she turned away were slow.)

day4_wait_goodbye.name: Me
day4_wait_goodbye.text: *We said our goodbyes and I turned to walk away. I wanted to look back… but I held myself back.*

day4_wait_regret.name: Me
day4_wait_regret.text: *I couldn't help it anymore and looked back. They had turned around too. The moment our eyes met, we both quickly looked away.*

day4_wait_home.name: Me
day4_wait_home.text: *On the way home. The words I couldn't say today sat heavy in a corner of my chest. 'Next time… I'll definitely say it. I have to.'*

day4_wait_end.name: Me
day4_wait_end.text: *In my heart… the unspoken words lingered.*
